content.name: Martin Gagnon
content.title: Head of Marketing
content.summary: Bilingual marketing leader with 16 years in Western Canadian insurance, energy services and co-operative food brands. Runs a 14-person marketing team and a $4.2M budget, and led the rebrand that moved unaided awareness in Alberta from 11% to 24%. Known for building marketing plans that finance and sales teams actually sign off on.

experience.title: Head of Marketing
bullets: Lead brand, digital, broker marketing and communications for a regional property and auto insurer, managing 14 staff and a $4.2M budget.
Directed a full rebrand across 38 broker offices and digital channels, doubling unaided awareness in Alberta within 20 months.
Partnered with underwriting to launch a farm insurance line in Saskatchewan, reaching $6.8M in written premium in its first year against a $5M target.
Replaced four disconnected agencies with one lead agency and an in-house studio, saving $610,000 a year while increasing creative output.
Built a French-language broker toolkit and campaign for Franco-Albertan communities, the company's first, now used by nine brokerages.

experience.title: Senior Marketing Manager
bullets: Owned acquisition marketing for furnace, solar and water heater rentals, generating 21,000 qualified leads a year for a 60-person sales team.
Shifted 40% of spend from print and radio to search and connected TV, lowering cost per installed customer from $214 to $163.
Designed a referral program with a $100 bill credit that produced 2,900 installs in its second year.
Managed a team of six and set up a shared dashboard with sales operations so weekly pipeline reviews used the same lead definitions.

experience.title: Brand Manager
bullets: Managed the yogurt and specialty cheese portfolio, worth $48M in annual retail sales across the Prairie provinces.
Launched a lactose-free milk line from consumer research to shelf in 11 months, capturing 9% category share in Alberta by year two.
Negotiated promotional calendars with three national grocery banners, improving trade spend efficiency by 14%.
Commissioned packaging redesign that met new bilingual labelling requirements and cut print costs by $120,000 a year.

experience.title: Marketing Coordinator
bullets: Coordinated flyers, catalogues and in-store events for six stores, keeping a 300-item seasonal production schedule on time.
Started the retailer's first email newsletter and grew it to 34,000 subscribers.
Ran ski-swap and bike-tune events that brought 5,000 visitors a season and became an annual fixture.

education.school: Haskayne School of Business, University of Calgary

achievements.title: Rebrand awareness gain
achievements.detail: Unaided awareness in Alberta rose from 11% to 24% after the 2022–23 rebrand.

achievements.title: Agency consolidation
achievements.detail: Saved $610,000 a year by restructuring agency roster and building an in-house studio.

achievements.title: Mentoring
achievements.detail: Volunteer mentor with a Calgary business school alumni program since 2019.
